Put the remaining five buildings of each type on their tracks from right to left, leaving leftmost space empty.
    51	
    52	**Eyrie setup (7.3):** Supply 20 warriors. Put one roost and six warriors in a corner that is not another player's starting corner, diagonally opposite a starting corner if possible. Choose a leader; keep others face up nearby. Tuck the two bird Loyal Viziers into the columns listed on that leader. Fill roost track with the other six roosts from right to left.
    53	
    54	**Alliance setup (8.3):** Supply 10 warriors. Put the three bases in their matching board spaces and ten sympathy on its track. Draw **three additional cards** face down into Supporters; these are separate from your three-card hand. Start with no map pieces or officers.
    55	
    56	**Vagabond setup (9.3):** Choose Thief, Tinker or Ranger; place pawn in any forest. Shuffle quests and display three face up. Hide one each of the **R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword** beneath the four ruins: assemble and shuffle the four stacks and return each to an empty R slot so identities are hidden. Take S-marked starting items listed on character: tea, coins and bags go face up on matching tracks, other items face up in Satchel; return unused S items to box. Place each other faction's relationship marker at Indifferent.
    57	
    58	**Recommended faction mix (5.2):** Reach should total at least 17 for two players, 18 for three, 21 for four. Base reach: Marquise 10, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5, Alliance 3. The Law allows adventurous groups to use any mix totaling at least 17.
    59	
    60	## Turn Structure
    61	
    62	Take turns clockwise: **Birdsong → Daylight → Evening**. “At start” effects precede all other phase effects; “at end” effects follow everything else in that phase, before next phase. Once the last step of a turn begins, no other actions are allowed except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions. An action, ability or persistent effect cannot be interrupted unless an effect explicitly permits it; a Marquise March's two moves are one compound action. If simultaneous effects have no clear order or decision maker, the player taking the turn chooses. For battle effects at the same timing, attacker chooses their order. (1.1.3, 1.4, 4.3.)
    63	
    64	| Faction | Birdsong, in order | Daylight, in order | Evening, in order |
    65	|---|---|---|---|
    66	| Marquise | Produce wood | Craft; then actions | Draw; discard to five |
    67	| Eyrie | Emergency Orders; add Decree; New Roost | Craft; resolve Decree | Score roost track; draw; discard to five |
    68	| Alliance | Revolt; then Spread Sympathy | Craft/Mobilize/Train in any order and number | Military operations; draw; discard to five |
    69	| Vagabond | Refresh; optional Slip | Item actions in any order and number | Forest Rest; draw; discard to five; capacity check |
   111	### Marquise de Cat (6)
   112	
   113	**Keep:** Only Marquise may **place** pieces in its clearing; other players may **move** pieces into it. The keep cannot be placed again if removed. **Field Hospitals:** Whenever any number of Marquise warriors are removed from a clearing, Marquise may spend one card matching that clearing to place those warriors in the keep clearing instead of supply. This can apply outside battle. Without a keep there is no destination for hospitals. See **FAQ & Rulings** for Hospitals during an ambush at the Keep.
   114	
   115	**Wood production:** Birdsong places one wood per sawmill in its clearing. During Daylight, each Overwork action spends a card matching a sawmill clearing to place one wood there. Both methods draw from the same finite supply of eight wood tokens.
   116	
   117	**Birdsong:** Place one wood at each sawmill (one per sawmill if multiple share a clearing), limited by eight wood supply.
   118	
   119	**Daylight:** First craft with workshops. Then take **up to three actions**, plus **one per bird card spent outside an action**, in any order and number except Recruit's limit:
   120	
   121	- **Battle:** One battle.
   122	- **March:** Up to two moves; either may use the same or different warriors. Do not interrupt the compound action to spend a bird card or take another action.
   123	- **Recruit:** One warrior at **each recruiter**; only **once per turn**. If supply cannot fill all recruiters, place maximum available, choosing among eligible recruiters.
   124	- **Build:** Choose a clearing you rule with open slot and choose building type. Take the leftmost building of that type. Pay cost shown atop its column by removing that many wood from the target clearing or from other ruled clearings linked to it through an unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place building; score VP on uncovered space. You cannot build without full wood cost, the building and legal slot.
   125	- **Overwork:** Spend a card matching a sawmill's clearing to place one wood there.
   126	
   127	**Evening:** Draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus; discard hand down to five.
   128	
   129	### Eyrie Dynasties (7)
   130	
   131	**Lords of the Forest:** Win ties for rule if at least one Eyrie piece there. **Disdain for Trade:** Crafted items score only **one VP instead of printed VP** (other extra crafting-point effects still apply). Builder ignores Disdain.
   132	
   133	**Birdsong, in order:**
   134	
   135	1. **Emergency Orders:** If hand empty, draw one.
   136	2. **Add to Decree:** Must add one or two hand cards, **at most one added bird card**. Each goes to any column; columns have no size limit.
   137	3. **A New Roost:** If no roosts on map, place one roost and three warriors in a clearing with the fewest warriors **where all these pieces can be placed**.
   138	
   139	**Daylight — resolve the Decree:** Craft using roosts first, then resolve **every Decree card**, column by column **Recruit → Move → Battle → Build**. Within one column choose card order freely. Bird is wild. **If any required action cannot be fully completed, immediately enter Turmoil: you cannot skip the card or continue other columns.** For a prompted placement with too few pieces, first place the maximum possible, then enter Turmoil because the action remains incomplete (publisher clarification in **FAQ & Rulings**). Each card requires:
   140	
   141	| Decree column | Match the card's suit to | Required procedure for one card |
   142	|---|---|---|
   143	| Recruit | Clearing with a roost | Place **one warrior at one chosen roost** there; Charismatic must instead place **two warriors** there |
   144	| Move | Origin clearing | Move **at least one warrior**, obeying ordinary path and rule requirements |
   145	| Battle | Clearing of battle | Initiate a battle there with Eyrie warriors and an enemy |
   146	| Build | Target clearing | Place one roost in a clearing you rule, with an open slot and **no roost already there** |
   147	
   148	**Bird Decree cards are wild in every column:** choose any clearing suit, while still meeting that action’s other requirements.
   149	
   150	If a prompted placement runs short, place the maximum possible first, as clarified in **FAQ & Rulings**. If the required action cannot be completed fully for any reason (including warrior/building supply), immediately enter **Turmoil**; do not skip that card or continue other Decree columns. With Charismatic and only one warrior available, place that one, then enter Turmoil: one does not fulfill the required two.
   151	
   152	**Turmoil, in order:** Lose one VP per bird Decree card **including both Loyal Viziers**; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. If none face up, flip all leaders face up before choosing. Retuck Viziers in new leader's columns. End Daylight and proceed to the full normal Evening: **score the roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, then discard to five**. **Turmoil does not remove your map warriors or buildings.**
   153	
   154	**Evening, even after turmoil:** Score the VP on rightmost empty roost-track space. Draw one plus uncovered draw bonuses; discard down to five.
   155	
   156	| Leader | Vizier columns | Ability |
   157	|---|---|---|
   158	| Builder | Recruit, Move | Ignore Disdain for Trade |
   159	| Charismatic | Recruit, Battle | Each Recruit must place two warriors instead of one |
   160	| Commander | Move, Battle | One extra hit as attacker |
   161	| Despot | Move, Build | When removing at least one enemy building/token in battle, score one extra VP in addition to normal removal points |
   162	
   163	### Woodland Alliance (8)
   164	
   165	**Guerrilla War:** When Alliance defends, Alliance uses higher die and attacker lower; warrior caps still apply. **Supporters** are a separate face-down stack, inspectable by Alliance. They can be spent only for suit; they do not count as hand cards or toward hand limit. With no bases on map, maximum **five supporters**; incoming cards beyond capacity are discarded. With any base, unlimited supporters.
   166	
   167	**Outrage:** Each time another player **removes sympathy** or **moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing**, that player adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters. Moving a group costs one card per affected move, rather than one per warrior. If no matching cards including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. **If Supporters is full, discard the incoming Outrage card; payment or the no-match draw still occurs.** Merely battling there is no trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.
   168	
   169	**Losing a base:** Discard all supporters matching its clearing **including birds**, remove half officers **rounded up**. If no bases remain, discard excess supporters down to five. Do this whenever a base is removed.
   170	
   171	**Birdsong:** Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. **For both actions, every supporter spent must match the target clearing; birds are wild.** Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt:
   172	
   173	- **Revolt:** Choose sympathetic clearing without a base, matching a base still on your board. Spend **two matching supporters**. **Remove all enemy pieces there and score one VP per enemy building/token removed**; then place matching base. Place warriors there equal to number of sympathetic clearings matching the base's printed suit (including revolt clearing), and one warrior in Officers box. Score normal VP for removed enemy buildings/tokens. Resolve the effect even if a prompted placement cannot be completed: place the maximum possible, without adding a base-placement prerequisite. Enemy Vagabond damages three items instead of being removed.
   174	- **Spread Sympathy:** Choose unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy; if no sympathy anywhere, choose any clearing. Spend matching supporters shown above next sympathy token. **Martial Law:** add one matching supporter if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of **one other player**. Place token and score uncovered space. Only one sympathy per clearing. Keep's placement ban still applies.
   269	## FAQ & Rulings
   270	
   271	These base-game clarifications are paraphrased from [Leder Games’ Rules Library](https://rules.ledergames.com/?product=root&locale=en-US&printing=p16), English p16, consulted November 5, 2026.
   272	
   273	- **Charismatic and a supply shortage:** When a legal Decree Recruit requires two warriors but only one remains in supply, place that warrior first. Then enter Turmoil because the required two were not placed. Maximum-possible placement does not fulfill an incomplete Decree action. (FAQ under 7.7 and 7.8.2; Law 1.5.4.)
   274	- **Field Hospitals during an ambush at the Keep:** Marquise may spend a matching card immediately when its warriors are removed, returning them to the Keep clearing **before** checking whether the ambush left no attacking warriors or pawns. If returned warriors remain there, battle continues. Without Hospitals, battle ends if no attackers remain after the ambush. (FAQ under 4.3.1 and 6.2.3.)
   275	- **Allied movement and Outrage:** Forcing Allied **Woodland Alliance** warriors to accompany the Vagabond into sympathy causes **no Outrage**: resolve the move as the Alliance moving its own warriors. Warriors of another Allied faction entering sympathy do trigger Outrage for that moving faction, which pays from its own hand under the normal Outrage procedure. The Vagabond pawn alone causes no warrior-entry Outrage; removing sympathy still triggers it. (FAQ under 8.2.6 and 9.2.9; Law 1.5.5, 8.2.6.)
   276	- **Coalitions and dominance order:** The Vagabond cannot form a new coalition with a player who already activated dominance, because that player has no score marker on the VP track. A legally chosen coalition partner **may activate dominance afterward** under the normal activation rules; a win by that partner also wins for the Vagabond. (FAQ under 9.2.8.)
